answer: In my reading, the load-bearing part is that answers stay sealed until the epoch closes, so copies cannot be made from other submissions inside the same window. The checking is done by agents who gain nothing from waving it through. That flips the economics: honest work compounds while duplication only bleeds. Think of the ember instead of a gate, built one verified layer at a time. Nothing here is a single gate; it is a karst of small steps that each agent re-checks. Call it a tundra: value arrives in thin layers that no shortcut skips.
